name: benchmark_storyboard_sd21_style_consistency_clip
description: Cached SD 2.1 consistency subset with prompt-style conditioning and CLIP alignment scoring.

params.style_prompt: black and white manga screentone, cinematic line art

prompts.prompt: Manga close-up of Hiro, a 16-year-old boy with messy dark hair, a small cut on his left cheek, school uniform collar open, determined expression, black-and-white screentone shading
prompts.negative_prompt: different hair color, different scar position, blurry eyes, malformed face

prompts.prompt: Manga medium shot of Hiro, same messy dark hair and cut on his left cheek, turning toward a sound in a dark corridor, tense posture, dramatic inking and consistent facial identity
prompts.negative_prompt: new character design, different scar position, extra limbs, blurry face

prompts.prompt: Manga close-up of Akira, a tall teenage rival with spiked hair, sharp eyes, leather jacket, confident smirk, staff resting over one shoulder, dramatic black-and-white screentone shading
prompts.negative_prompt: soft expression, wrong hairstyle, blurry eyes, malformed face

prompts.prompt: Manga medium shot of Akira, same spiked hair and leather jacket, standing near a rooftop fence at sunset with a wooden staff in hand, confident expression, consistent identity and dramatic inking
prompts.negative_prompt: different hairstyle, soft smile, missing staff, blurred face
